items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: What's Tommy's name? Thomas- Jefferson? No. Thomas. Yeah, Thomas, in New Orleans. Thomas- Oakland- Oakland- Uptown he played piano and guitar. Tom.
